name: Enterprise Event Sourcing with Audit Trail
requirement: Build a financial transaction system requiring complete audit trail and time-travel queries
notes: Event sourcing is the only pattern that satisfies both audit_trail and time_travel

name: Multi-Cloud Disaster Recovery
requirement: Deploy the same AI service across AWS and Azure for disaster recovery with 99.99% availability
notes: Only multi-cloud pattern satisfies both constraints

name: Zero Trust Healthcare
requirement: Build a healthcare platform with compliance and zero trust security model
notes: Zero trust is required for healthcare compliance

name: Real-time Event Streaming
requirement: Build a real-time analytics platform processing 1M events per second
notes: Only Kafka satisfies both real_time and event_driven at this scale

name: ML Training Pipeline
requirement: Build an ML pipeline for training and deploying recommendation models with full MLOps
notes: ML Pipeline pattern includes MLflow for reproducibility

name: Agentic Workflow with Audit
requirement: Build a workflow automation system with human oversight and complete audit trail
notes: Agentic workflow is the only pattern with both audit_trail and human_oversight

name: Kubernetes Auto-scaling
requirement: Migrate to microservices on Kubernetes with auto-scaling
notes: K8s is the only pattern with both microservices and auto_scaling

name: Cost-Efficient Self-Hosted RAG
requirement: Build a RAG system that is self-hosted and cost-efficient
notes: Basic RAG is the only RAG pattern with both self_hosted and cost_efficient

name: Serverless Low-Ops
requirement: Build an MVP with minimal operations overhead
notes: Serverless pattern satisfies both serverless and low_ops

name: Zero Downtime Deployment
requirement: Deploy with zero downtime and instant rollback capability
notes: Blue-green is the only pattern with zero_downtime
